notes.title: Remaster Planned
notes.content:
As we are all aware, the game is great. Too great. At being [b]bad[/b], we (I) I have decided to remaster/rebuild from the ground up the story of Fred & Karen.


[b] Work Begins. [/b]

I will be starting from the ground up, in Unity the short story of Fred & Karen. This will be a total remake, and I plan to actually make the game quality. 

More to come soon. Post ideas below, and watch for more updates!

notes.title: Ten up votes and this beast will get remastered.
notes.content: Hit me with the 10 up votes and I will remaster this beauty to make it EVEN more enjoyable.

notes.title: Ok Gamers big update
notes.content:
[b] Small bug fixes and other things.. [/b]

Give her a shot!
[list]
[*] Leaving/Joining should now be fixed
[*] End Game should work, not sure.
[*]Voices, and all sounds have been turned down.
[*]Monsters are stronger and more aggressive.
[*] Monsters eyes are darker and hard to see.
[*]Third Person is now back.
[/list]

[u]Achievements are going out today, you can find them on steam and how to get them should be pretty easy.[/u]
Thanks 
- Milkweedgg

notes.title: Achievements and monster rework & TPP
notes.content:
The FPP looks kind of terrible, I am going to move it back to the TPP and modify the monsters to make them more "scary" as well as add some achievements.

The Achievements will be relatively easy so 100% can be possible. Thanks!
